articles.author: Evelyn Cheng, Priyanka Salve
articles.title: China's Xi builds diplomatic clout with multiple state visits ahead of Trump summit - CNBC
articles.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to make his first visit to India before traveling to the U.S. for a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.
